g.text: E040 · Shared-weight projection — not engine performance
M5 Ultra · real Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 weights · K=5,120 · synthetic BF16 inputs · 2026-10-19
Small marks: all five sequential groups. Large marks: median of the five group ratios. Focused ratio scale.
Each group: 20 paired AB/BA samples per baseline; fresh operations + eval + synchronization + concat/staging.
Above 1 favors the candidate. Head T4/T8 beat both local baselines; other cases are mixed.
